verdict_B_runner_oracle_quality_and_diag.finding: The social feedback poll samples only a boolean and discards which of its conditions failed. It queries button[title=...] inside the linked SEO pane and then svg.lucide-check. The shared click helper explicitly accepts either title or data-matrx-title because the mounted design-system TooltipProvider lifts title while a button is hovered or focused; an earlier SEO copy feedback poll likewise accepts both attributes. The social poll can therefore return false even if the click copied successfully and the check icon appeared. The tooltip also restores title on pointerdown, so the existing receipt's false value alone cannot prove that this selector mismatch actually occurred. The component may instead show its red failure icon after clipboard write/fallback failure, or the short success state may have gone unobserved. The current 10-second, 100-ms poll has no evidence for a timeout fix.
verdict_B_runner_oracle_quality_and_diag.product_contract: SeoVerdict renders the social CopyButton when missingSocialTagsSnippet is present. CopyButton awaits copyToClipboard, renders Check on true or X on false, then resets to idle after 1200 ms. copyToClipboard tries navigator.clipboard.writeText and falls back to document.execCommand('copy'); a false result represents both paths failing. The existing receipt contains neither the button icon state nor a clipboard read after the click.
